dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: This is one of our most popular paintings. What do you think of it?
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ɪz ˈwʌn əv aʊr ˈmoʊst ˈpɑːpjələr ˈpeɪntɪŋz. ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk əv ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's very colorful. It looks as if someone threw paint at it!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈvɛri ˈkʌlərfəl. ɪt ˈlʊks əz ɪf ˈsʌmwʌn ˈθruː ˈpeɪnt ət ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! Many people say that. It's an abstract painting, so it doesn't show real things.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ ˈðæt. ɪts ən ˈæbstrækt ˈpeɪntɪŋ, soʊ ɪt ˈdʌzənt ˈʃoʊ ˈriːəl ˈθɪŋz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But look at these lines. It looks as though the river is moving.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ˈlʊk ət ðiːz ˈlaɪnz. ɪt ˈlʊks əz ðoʊ ðə ˈrɪvər ɪz ˈmuːvɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes! The artist wanted it to look like water. Can you see all the shades of blue?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ði ˈɑːrtɪst ˈwɑːntɪd ɪt tə ˈlʊk ˈlaɪk ˈwɔːtər. kən juː ˈsiː ˈɔːl ðə ˈʃeɪdz əv ˈbluː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: There are so many. Some are bright, and some are quite dull.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ər soʊ ˈmɛni. sʌm ər ˈbraɪt, ənd sʌm ər ˈkwaɪt ˈdʌl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The dull shades make the water seem deep.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈdʌl ˈʃeɪdz ˈmeɪk ðə ˈwɔːtər ˈsiːm ˈdiːp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And this bright yellow looks as if the sun is on the water.
dialogue.reading: ənd ðɪs ˈbraɪt ˈjɛloʊ ˈlʊks əz ɪf ðə ˈsʌn ɪz ɑːn ðə ˈwɔːtər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Exactly. It seems as if you understand abstract art already!
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli. ɪt ˈsiːmz əz ɪf juː ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈæbstrækt ˈɑːrt ɔːlˈrɛdi!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Then maybe I'll start painting, too!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈðɛn ˈmeɪbi aɪl ˈstɑːrt ˈpeɪntɪŋ, ˈtuː!
